introduction: Kristi finally becomes pregnant with the help of a chip called the synthetic brain, but she suddenly dies in a car accident. Her husband, Tom, is left alone with the newborn. He agrees to resurrect his wife by transplanting her recorded consciousness into the body of an Italian surrogate named Beatrice. Kristi struggles with her new body, and Tom struggles with her changed identity. Just when it seems they have succeeded in saving their family, Beatrice learns the true purpose of the experiment she has become. She decides to escape and comes face to face with the truest version of herself.
